reasons: The first PromQL term uses a fixed range [5m] on rate(), which the hard rules forbid; the only allowed range is [$__rate_interval].

The $host template variable has prefix host and default *, so the rules require a matcher host=~"$host" on both metrics. The candidate omits it, so the series set is not the same as the Datadog request.
The Datadog $scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. The $key variable is not used in any query, so ignoring it is also correct.
Quantity, unit (hit ratio times 100 as in the source) and aggregation (avg of per-series rates) match the Datadog request. The outcome is translated, which is correct since no function is used.
